rolling_policy: Shift each input series by one day before calculating rolling statistics. Features at date t must not include weather observed after t.
split_policy: Assign samples by target date, not feature-origin date. Historical inputs before a target date may cross the development/holdout boundary.

forecast_origin_convention.forecast_origin: End of day t, after day t weather observations are available
forecast_origin_convention.current_features: Weather observations on day t, explicitly named with _current
forecast_origin_convention.lag_features: lag_1 means day t-1; lag_k means day t-k
forecast_origin_convention.rolling_features: Rolling windows end on day t and include the observation on day t
forecast_origin_convention.targets: T_plus_h means the target observation on day t+h
forecast_origin_convention.availability_rule: Every predictor must be available at the forecast origin
